title: Rivu bounded framed raw PCM inference request v2

channels.description: Separation requires stereo; no implicit downmix.

frames.description: At most four hours at sample_rate; exact interleaved float32-le PCM follows in bounded frames. No paths, temporary files or spill fallback.

model_manifest.description: Explicit node-local provisioned bundle manifest emitted by prepare.py/provision.py; unbundled construction manifests are not inference inputs. Required runtime metadata binds this manifest, hashed runtime sidecars/worker notice and interpreter identity; dependencies records installed versions, supplied license metadata and hashed notices matching every model package pin. Speech IDs: MossFormer2_SE_48K, DeepFilterNet3. Separation ID: melband_roformer_kim. Every artifact requires SHA256 and factual weight-license/provenance evidence; no license grant inferred. No global registry, implicit download, alternate model or device fallback.

wet_mix.description: Source-rate linear dry/wet blend. Zero preserves original samples bit-exactly.

attenuation_limit_db.description: Minimum spectral mask gain, not waveform clipping or level normalization.

post_filter.description: Only DeepFilterNet3 supports this parameter. Presence is rejected for MossFormer2, including false.
